verdict_summary: TotalEnergies-owned 455 MW project; 17 OSM solar-plant polygons confirm footprint between Liverpool and Petson 138kV substations; energization approved May 2024; timelapse shows construction 2023-Q1 through 2024-Q1, modules installed and stable through 2026-Q2.

project_area.source: No Ch.313/JETI or IA obtained to state explicit acreage; OSM polygon cluster bounding box suggests 3,000-4,000 acres; TotalEnergies documents state 455 MW capacity

cod_assessment.drift_history: 25 changes since 2018; original 2020-11-01; continuous monthly slipping since mid-2024; TotalEnergies itself announced 'end of 2024' COD in Dec 2023 — that slipped a full year+
cod_assessment.key_factor: Project is physically complete and energized (May 2024) but COD approval not yet granted by ERCOT; likely commissioning/testing/contractual delay, not construction. Pattern suggests ERCOT approval is the near-term gating item.
cod_assessment.rationale: Energization + sync both approved May 2024; 14+ months of monthly slipping with no ERCOT commercial operation sign-off; could be ERCOT operating test, LyondellBasell PPA commercial terms, or regulatory hold; physical construction is done
